label: Distinct real realizers contribute to the same intrinsic actuality
definition: For each eligible specification c, if its realizer is a real constituent of b and differs from the designated whole, the fact specification(c) explains the SAME target actuality at w. RealConstituent retains d6912ecb-aed2-411a-913e-0dab9106d910. The realizer and fact maps are declared primitive interpretations: the former identifies the real actuality realizing the item; the latter identifies the fact appropriate to this constitutive explanation. The guard spares the whole nature itself. A proper actualizing form in a composite motivates the principle; a remote cause, an object merely apprehended, a non-synonymous predicate, or the whole realizing itself is not automatically a strict contributor. Structural properties of explanation remain separate.
note: OPEN necessary bridge for this diagnostic, not a definition settling constituency and not a biconditional or sufficiency theorem. The independently motivated sufficient example of a real intrinsic proper co-principle constituting a whole does not establish this necessary coverage claim for every purported constituent. Apply identically to intentional contents and noncognitive formal modes; whether the given fact map carries the required constitutive actuality remains open.
